status: identity-free contextual supplement; original preparation verification retained

cohort.selection: Smallest full mailing-list index, then newest complete calendar month preceding newest archive month; frozen before message-content labeling

unit: One indexed source message; new authored information requests only; related threads do not establish independent-user counts.

accounting.conservation: 2 included + 3 exact-duplicate rows + 182 other excluded rows = 187; the 2 ambiguous cases are a subset of the 182

annotation: Codex direct reading of all 187 message views with raw-source recheck of request candidates; root session independently checked 15 candidate/boundary cases. Model-assisted audit, not human evaluation or blind double coding.

interpretation: Actual correspondence grounds uses of revision and disposition records inside a larger cross-WG dependency workflow. Dependency clearance and impact judgments require evidence beyond those stored records. The request cohort adds a documented scope map rather than empirical coverage for designed CQ or operator templates.
privacy_projection: Sender names, email addresses, source URLs, original message identifiers, signatures and raw bodies are retained only in private evidence. Public snippets preserve technical request language and contribution identifiers.
